title: On the Ultimate Origin of Things
summary: Why infinite past time could never deliver sufficient reason, and why the universe must be traced to a necessary being who chooses the best.
sourceNote: Seed text: G. M. Duncan, The Philosophical Works of Leibnitz (New Haven, 1908), translated from the Latin; OCR transcription from the archive.org scan (worksofleibniz00leibuoft), US public domain.
